entries.zh: 屏，屏风；卧室内分隔用的屏障（西语 alcoba 亦可指壁凹小间、隔间）
entries.en: folding screen, partition screen; alcove, recessed chamber (alcoba)

entries.zh: 门屏，门前屏风；格栅隔屏（cancel）
entries.en: screen before the door, entrance screen; lattice or grating partition (cancel)

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: L、H 栏残缺，M、R 栏空白，无从定词。

entries.zh: 镜，镜子
entries.en: mirror
entries.notes: 西语词头 Albaua/Albava 存疑，且 M 音写 cuang/cuan 与“鏡”音不合，仅据汉字“鏡”定释义，待复核。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 仅 M 栏存残迹，余栏皆空，无从定词。

entries.zh: 乡社，乡村聚落；乡里村社（社坛所在之乡里）
entries.en: village, rural community; hamlet (aldea, pueblo)

entries.zh: 乡下，乡野；小村落
entries.en: countryside, rural area; small village (aldea pequeña)
entries.notes: M 栏仅存 hiõ 其后残缺；西语 pegueña 疑为 pequeña 之讹。

entries.zh: 乡村，农村；小村庄
entries.en: village, countryside; rural hamlet

entries.zh: 乡里，家乡故里；乡里邻里
entries.en: village or township; one's native place, home district
entries.notes: 词义依“鄉里”可定，但 M 栏音调记号污损难辨（T99），按规降低置信。

entries.zh: 村，村庄；乡野的、村俗的（aldeano 乡民、村夫）
entries.en: village; rustic, villager-like (aldeano)
entries.notes: 西语 Qajo/Gajo 存疑未能落实；M 作 chuy 与 R 作 chun 不一致，依汉字“村”释义。

entries.zh: 村气，土气；乡野粗俗之气、村夫气
entries.en: rustic air, uncouth country manner; boorishness
entries.notes: 西语 Rosco/Bosco 存疑（疑为 tosco“粗野”之讹读），M quy/guy 亦有疑记，依“村氣”与 aldeano 语境释义。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕

entries.zh: 畅快，舒畅；畅（身心畅适）
entries.en: cheerful and at ease, refreshed; to enjoy oneself, be merry (holgarse)

entries.zh: 畅趣，畅快之乐趣；快意
entries.en: delight, pleasure; cheerfulness
entries.notes: M 栏另有 COT./COR. 疑记，或为稿面订正记号，不影响汉字释义。

entries.zh: 乐，快乐；喜悦
entries.en: joy, gladness; delight (gozo)

entries.zh: 乐然，快乐的样子；欣然自得
entries.en: joyful, gladly; contented and happy

entries.zh: 称，相称、称意；因受善益好处而喜悦
entries.en: to fit, be agreeable; joy taken in good things received
entries.notes: 西语残句 reciue 疑为 recibe、句意欠通，依汉字“稱”及同页“稱意/稱心”定释义。

entries.zh: 称意，如意、满意；称心遂意
entries.en: satisfactory, to one's liking; pleased with good things and good fortune
entries.notes: 西语残句 hico 疑为 hecho 之讹、句有缺损；依“稱意”释义。

entries.zh: 称心，称心如意；心中满意
entries.en: to one's heart's content; gratifying, agreeable
entries.notes: 西语残句存疑同上（hico/chico）；汉字“稱心”明确。

entries.zh: 玩，玩耍；消遣娱乐
entries.en: to play, amuse oneself; pastime, recreation

entries.zh: 玩弄，戏耍摆弄；戏弄、嘲弄
entries.en: to toy with, play with; to mock, tease (burlar)

entries.zh: 慨然，慷慨爽快之貌；心悦意畅
entries.en: with open-hearted cheer; generously, with a glad mind
entries.notes: 汉字“慨然”与西语 alegre mente（快乐地）对应松散，取汉字本义兼顾西语；词头或为 alegremente 之分写。
